fields.statement: Built rhiza from the branch head and, in a scratch repo with its own HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME, ran machine show, api call machine.show, health and session start --permission-mode bypassPermissions (refused, naming machine.toml) with no machine config: XDG_CONFIG_HOME stayed empty (no rhiza dir, no file). Then with machine.toml trust = "daily": the same ops plus machine show --json left the file byte-identical (cmp), same mtime and mode, trust still daily. go test ./internal/machine and TestScripts/machine-trust-unwritten pass. Mutations: an aliased xos.WriteFile and an O_RDWR OpenFile in internal/machine plus a new export Raise fail TestMachineNeverWritesFiles and TestMachineExportsOnlyReaders; fp.Join(..., "machine.toml") in internal/api fails TestNothingElseTouchesMachineFile. A const-held "machine.toml" passed to filepath.Join outside internal/machine is not caught.

With the branch-head build, rhiza machine show printed 'trust: daily (no machine config; it would be <path>)' with no file and 'trust: daily (from <path>)' with a daily file; machine show --json and api call machine.show printed the same bytes ({file,path,trust}); describe --json names only the read op machine.show; neither run wrote the config.
